five_day_thesis: The regime changed from range-bound chop to a gamma-supported breakout. Spot traced $4,159.7 → $4,106.1 → $4,089.8 → $4,151.8 → $4,304.3, with the entire +$144.6 five-day gain delivered in the final session. The decisive shift is dealer gamma: window net GEX ran +54.6, then +9.3, then flipped negative to -10.65 on 2026-08-04, recovered to +79.1, and exploded to +294.3 on 2026-08-06 — a 3.7x expansion that turns dealers into aggressive dampeners above the money. The gamma flip strike migrated up with it, $3,345 → $3,300 → $3,300 → $3,345 → $3,450, now $854 beneath spot, meaning the whole tradeable band sits in long-gamma territory. Meanwhile ATM IV compressed 22.02% → 21.36% (-0.66pp) even as spot rallied 3.5%, an unusual up-and-quiet combination that favors premium sellers over breakout buyers.
